name: Kan'in Tokkyuu Michishio ~Akumu no Sanshuukan~
original_name: 姦淫特急 満潮～悪夢の三週間～
source:
"Senpai. How’s the haul this time?"

The Kan'in Tokkyuu Michishio—a train infamous for capturing women and turning them into livestock—had once been part of a larger organization. But that group had crumbled years ago. Now, Takatsuki and I had built our own group from the ground up, and we’d successfully taken control of everything the organization once stood for.

"No promising catches yet. But it’s a long journey ahead. Let’s take it slow, yeah?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx/work/=/product_id/VJ011333.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
「前辈，这次的收获怎么样？」

因捕获女性并将她们变成家畜而臭名昭著的「奸淫特急·满潮」，曾属于一个更大的组织。但那个组织数年前便已瓦解。如今，高槻和我白手起家组建了自己的团体，成功接管了原组织曾代表的一切。

「还没发现有潜力的猎物。不过路途还长，慢慢来吧？」
